# agv_pro_simulations

ROS2 packages for agv_pro_simulations

> Software environment for Jetson Orin Nano

```
ubuntu 22.04
ros2 humble
```

# Installation

Create workspace and clone the repository.

```
git clone https://github.com/elephantrobotics/agv_pro_simulations.git agv_pro_simulations/src
```

Install dependencies

```
cd ~/agv_pro_simulations

rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y
```

Build workspace

```
cd ~/agv_pro_simulations

colcon build
```

Setup the workspace

```
source ~/agv_pro_simulations/install/local_setup.bash
```

# Update to new version

```
cd ~/agv_pro_simulations/src

git pull

cd ..

colcon build
```

## 4.Gazebo simulation navigation

 （1） Switch to the map that was just saved

   Open the navigation2_sim.launch.py file in the agv_pro_navigation2 folder

![agvpro_13](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/233889221/567605396-3f30e67a-99d6-4ae1-9634-f4d0ee40437d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3NzQyNTY0MDgsIm5iZiI6MTc3NDI1NjEwOCwicGF0aCI6Ii8yMzM4ODkyMjEvNTY3NjA1Mzk2LTNmMzBlNjdhLTk5ZDYtNGFlMS05NjM0LWY0ZDBlZTQwNDM3ZC5wbmc_.U4FYUC2PjwmrldjpvZaJ19ldoD4Xw6TjIcD2rcVgmBU)

 （2） Recompile after switching maps

```
cd agv_pro_simulations
colcon build --packages-select agv_pro_navigation2
```

 （3） Start simulation navigation

   Close all terminals and reopen two terminals

```
ros2 launch agv_pro_gazebo simulation.launch.py
```

```
ros2 launch agv_pro_navigation2 navigation2_sim.launch.py 
```
